thesis.headline: One day, governments will build correctional facilities for bad AI agents.
thesis.lead: The next decade of AI isn't about smarter models. It's about accountable ones — good agents, bad agents, and the systems that catch, correct, and release them. That's the problem I'm obsessed with.
premise: In airborne software (DO-178B) and industrial robotics, systems are never certified because they "usually behave well in a demo." They are certified because their failure modes are bounded, their telemetry is immutable, and their fallback states are deterministic.

As enterprise AI moves from chat interfaces to autonomous multi-agent workflows with tool-execution privileges, probabilistic drift becomes an operational hazard. Killing a misbehaving agent destroys forensic state; leaving it running risks cascading failure. We need Correctional Infrastructure for Autonomous Agents.

stages.name: The Flight Recorder
stages.body: Runtime monitors evaluate strict invariants (permission boundaries, schema drift, budget ceilings, PII egress). When an agent violates policy or enters an adversarial loop, its execution thread is suspended in sub-milliseconds while a clean standby instance hot-swaps into production.

stages.name: Quarantine
stages.body: The arrested agent's complete context window, tool-call graph, memory pointers, and random seed are snapshotted into an isolated execution jail where external APIs are replaced by deterministic mock sinks.

stages.name: Interrogation & Rehabilitation
stages.body: An automated diagnostic harness classifies the root cause (prompt injection, ambiguous tool schema, context poisoning, or reward hacking) and replays 100+ adversarial mutations of the failure state to synthesize a deterministic guardrail or routing patch.

stages.name: The Parole Board
stages.body: The patched agent must pass 100% of the adversarial regression suite and survive shadow-mode canary evaluation against live traffic before earning release back into autonomous production.

caseStudies.tag: 01 / AI STRATEGY, PRIVATE LLMs & MOBILITY INFRASTRUCTURE
caseStudies.meta: Head of Digital Solutions · Berlin · Feb 2024 – Present
caseStudies.headline: Holding enterprise AI and next-generation commercial mobility platforms to deterministic engineering standards.

matrix.domain: Next-gen commercial mobility infrastructure, private LLM deployments, multi-agent enterprise workflows, and vehicle-to-cloud digital architecture.
matrix.constraints: Strict European data sovereignty (GDPR/IP protection), zero tolerance for hallucinated operational data, and alignment across hardware, fleet operations, and executive strategy.
matrix.scope: End-to-end ownership of digital transformation, AI strategy, internal/external software platforms, and cross-functional engineering execution.
matrix.outcome: Architected data-sovereign private LLM and agentic workflows; unified fragmented digital toolchains into a scalable mobility platform roadmap.

tradeoff.context: In an industrial and mobility environment, standard cloud-hosted LLM wrappers fail two critical tests: they leak proprietary vehicle/operational IP and produce non-deterministic outputs unsuitable for business-critical workflows.
tradeoff.decision: Rejected generic third-party SaaS AI sprawl in favor of private LLM deployments coupled with bounded agentic workflows—where LLMs handle unstructured ingestion and synthesis, while deterministic code enforces validation, permissions, and state updates.
tradeoff.result: Delivered practical AI automation across engineering and operations while preserving 100% data sovereignty and predictable system behavior.

caseStudies.meta: Head of Product & Apps (AutoScout24) · Senior PM (Cluno / Cazoo) · Munich · 2019 – 2024
caseStudies.headline: Scaling Europe's largest automotive marketplace apps and pioneering digital car subscription lifecycles.

matrix.domain: Two-sided automotive marketplace (millions of monthly users) and full-lifecycle vehicle subscription e-commerce (onboarding, risk scoring, fleet logistics).
matrix.constraints: High-volume consumer conversion funnels tied to real-world physical inventory, credit underwriting, vehicle handover logistics, and multi-country post-merger integration.
matrix.scope: Led mobile/app product organization and core consumer journeys across native iOS, Android, and web ecosystems; also served as Advisory Board Member at HR-tech platform HirePlusPlus (2023–2024).
matrix.outcome: Scaled core mobile app engagement and conversion at continental scale (AutoScout24); architected digital subscription funnels through Cluno's rapid scale-up and acquisition by Cazoo.

tradeoff.context: In digital car subscriptions and marketplaces, optimizing purely for top-of-funnel click conversion creates downstream operational failure if financing checks, inventory locks, and delivery scheduling are decoupled.
tradeoff.decision: Bridged consumer-facing mobile UX directly with backend ERP and fleet reality—introducing real-time state validation early in the funnel and aligning cross-functional squads around completed vehicle handovers rather than vanity clicks.
tradeoff.result: Reduced drop-offs between digital contract signing and physical vehicle delivery while maintaining top-tier app store ratings and rapid release velocity.

caseStudies.meta: Head of Software Development & Engineering Lead · Aalen · May 2013 – Jan 2019
caseStudies.headline: Sub-millimeter robotic optical inspection and high-throughput 3D point-cloud processing on the factory floor.

matrix.domain: Industrial metrology, automated optical inspection, 3D laser/sensor point-cloud processing, CAD comparison, and real-time hardware control (C++, C#, WPF).
matrix.constraints: Sub-millimeter measurement precision, real-time memory management for multi-million-point 3D scans, and 24/7 deterministic stability on active manufacturing lines.
matrix.scope: Promoted from Engineering Lead to Head of Software Development; architected core software platforms and built/mentored the engineering team.
matrix.outcome: Shipped production-grade 3D metrology suites for industrial manufacturing; recognized with the Microsoft MVP Award for deep technical contributions and software leadership.

tradeoff.context: Processing massive 3D point clouds and rendering real-time CAD deviation heatmaps inside an operator-friendly desktop UI (C#/WPF) typically bottlenecks on garbage-collection pauses and CPU/GPU memory transfers.
tradeoff.decision: Architected a strict native/managed boundary—keeping heavy spatial indexing, point-cloud registration, and geometric math in deterministic, memory-pinned C++ pipelines while exposing a reactive, hardware-accelerated WPF operator workspace on top.
tradeoff.result: Achieved real-time 3D inspection visualization and strict cycle-time compliance on production lines without sacrificing operator ergonomics.

caseStudies.imageAlt: Robot arm with an optical sensor inspecting a car body in a factory hall

caseStudies.meta: Software Engineer / IT Analyst · TCS · Sep 2008 – May 2013
caseStudies.headline: Deterministic cockpit display systems and mathematical CAD foundations where bugs are not an option.

matrix.domain: Airborne cockpit display software (DO-178B safety certification) and computational geometry / CAD kernel engineering (C++).
matrix.constraints: Zero-defect tolerance, strict deterministic execution, structural code coverage (MC/DC), and full requirements-to-object-code traceability.
matrix.scope: Core systems engineering, safety-critical verification, and geometric algorithm implementation.
matrix.outcome: Forged the deterministic engineering discipline that underpins every system built since—from industrial robots to accountable AI agents.

tradeoff.context: In DO-178B avionics software, dynamic memory allocation, unbounded loops, and ambiguous state transitions are forbidden because every execution path must be mathematically provable under worst-case timing.
tradeoff.decision: Internalized deterministic state-machine design, strict requirement traceability, and failure-isolation patterns early—treating every external input as untrusted until verified.
tradeoff.result: Today, this safety-critical foundation is my core differentiator in AI: applying avionics-grade verification and containment to probabilistic LLMs.

teardowns.name: Leben in Deutschland
teardowns.summary: Zero-account, offline-first flashcard and exam simulator covering all 460 official BAMF questions (300 general + 16×10 state questions) with custom SVG scenes and plain-English cultural explainers.

points.title: Build-Time Factual Assertion Gate
points.body: Automatically catches and patches upstream community dataset hallucinations (such as Question 184's historical error on the 1948 founding of Israel) and fails the build loudly if upstream data regresses.

points.title: Zero-Data-Loss Cross-Domain Handover
points.body: Custom migration bridge carrying local AsyncStorage progress seamlessly from GitHub Pages to lid.utpaldas.com.

teardowns.name: Führerschein-Trainer
teardowns.kind: Class B Theory & Traffic Sign Simulator
teardowns.summary: Interactive German Class B driving theory trainer (Home, Learn, Signs, Exam, You) paired with the Living in Deutschland companion video curriculum covering high-failure right-of-way (Rechts vor links) and priority rules.

points.title: On-Device Readiness Engine
points.body: Calculates daily card velocity and projected exam pass dates locally with zero backend cost or user tracking.

points.title: Resilient State Migration
points.body: Automated cross-domain state transfer with local JSON backup/restore fallback for large progress payloads.

teardowns.name: B1-Trainer
teardowns.kind: Zertifikat Deutsch B1 · Goethe, telc & DTZ
teardowns.summary: 931 words across 22 themes, 166 grammar drills and 31 full exam tasks across Lesen, Hören, Schreiben and Sprechen — 1,097 items on a spaced-repetition schedule. Pick your certificate and the facts, timings and official links change to match.

points.title: Device-Spoken Listening
points.body: Hören is spoken aloud by your device rather than shipped as audio files, with the same play limit as the real exam.

points.title: No Pretend Grading
points.body: Lesen and Hören are scored against an answer key; Schreiben and Sprechen are not — you get the clock, the phrase bank, a model answer and the examiner's criteria as a checklist.

teardowns.name: We the Future
teardowns.summary: A mobile-first app showing government projects near you, with map and list discovery, search, and filters for planned, ongoing, delayed, completed and finished early.

points.title: Evidence Panel per Project
points.body: Every project carries official source links, source type, verification status, confidence, and when it was last verified.

points.title: Record ≠ Opinion
points.body: Verified facts and timelines are kept strictly separate from community ratings and reviews, so what the record says and what people say never blur together.

teardowns.name: Retailor
teardowns.kind: Tailor Your CV with the AI You Already Use
teardowns.summary: Put your CV in, copy a ready-made prompt into ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini or Perplexity along with the job advert, paste the reply back, review every change, and download a polished PDF.

points.title: Bring Your Own AI
points.code: no model API in the loop
points.body: The app never calls a model itself — you run the prompt in the assistant you already trust, so there is no API key, no sign-up and no upload.

points.title: Human-in-the-Loop Diff
points.body: Every suggested change is shown side by side and must be reviewed before the PDF is produced. Runs entirely in your browser, no tracking.
